[[File:Dragon scimitar detail.png|left|140px]]
The '''dragon scimitar''' is the strongest [[scimitar]] available in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. It can only be wielded by players who have 60 [[Attack]] and have completed the [[Monkey Madness I]] quest.

It may be purchased from [[Daga]] on [[Ape Atoll]] for 100,000 coins. A [[monkeyspeak amulet]] does not need to be worn, as players can just right-click 'Trade' on Daga; however, you still must be in [[Greegree|monkey form]], unless you have completed [[Monkey Madness II]] after which the monkey form is no longer required. Players who have freed [[King Awowogei]] in [[Recipe for Disaster]] can easily reach [[Marim]] through the [[Ape Atoll Teleport (standard)|Ape Atoll Teleport]] spell (requires 64 [[Magic]]) to access [[Daga's Scimitar Smithy|Daga's shop]] on Ape Atoll quicker. The scimitar is also a rare drop from the [[Wilderness]] boss [[Scorpia]] or the [[Zombie Pirate's Locker]].

As with most [[dragon equipment]], the dragon scimitar '''cannot''' be made from raw materials using the [[Smithing]] skill.

One good alternative is the [[Arkan blade]], which has very similar stats, the same 4-tick attack speed, and a great special attack, and is earned as a reward for completing [[The Final Dawn]] quest. This saves players the 100,000 coins used for purchasing the Dragon Scimitar.

==Special attack==
[[File:Sever.gif|frame|A player performing the dragon scimitar's special attack, ''Sever''.]]
The dragon scimitar has a [[special attacks|special attack]], ''Sever'', costing 55% of the player's special attack energy and rolls against the target's slash defence with 25% higher accuracy.{{CiteDiscord|author=Mod Rice|url=https://discord.com/channels/177206626514632704/269673599554551808/1430505068922142741|date=2025-10-22|quote=The dscim rolls with a maximum accuracy roll equal to its maximum accuracy roll + it's maximum accuracy roll divided by 4|archiveurl=|archivedate=|ctxquote=|notes=|name=}} In PvP fights, this special attack has an additional effect that, upon a [[successful hit]], disables the targeted player's active [[protection prayers]] ([[Protect from Magic]], [[Protect from Missiles]], and [[Protect from Melee]]) and prevents the targeted player from using said prayers for 8 ticks (4.8 seconds). 

==Comparison==
The dragon scimitar is one of the most easily attainable one-handed training weapons in the game. Its power is surpassed by weapons like the [[abyssal whip]] and the [[Ghrazi rapier]]. Due to [[whip]]s and [[hasta]]e being unable to solely train Strength, the dragon scimitar is often used to do so, and is therefore one of the most commonly used weapons in the game to train Strength.

It shares similar bonuses with [[Viggora's chainmace]], with the chainmace being a [[crush weapon]] rather than a [[slash weapon]].

==Ornament kit==
Players can attach a [[dragon scimitar ornament kit]] or a [[Bounty Hunter ornament kit]] to cosmetically enhance the scimitar, creating a [[dragon scimitar (or)]] or [[dragon scimitar (cr)]] respectively. This only alters its appearance, and gives no stat enhancements. It can be dismantled, returning the scimitar and ornament kit.

==Trivia==
*The dragon scimitar was not actually released until almost four months after the release of the [[Monkey Madness I]] quest on [[29 March]] [[2005]].
*If the player asks [[Zeke]] to sell them a dragon scimitar before completing Monkey Madness I, he will say "Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you'll ever hold a dragon scimitar." This is an {{wp|Monkey's uncle|idiom}}, but also a literal reference to Monkey Madness I in which the player plays the role of a monkey's uncle to complete the quest, as completing the quest is required to wield the dragon scimitar.
*The Dragon scimitar originally had a [[Special attacks|special attack]] that stopped your opponent from moving for a short period of time but Jagex later changed it in [[Update:Dragon Scimitar Change|an update]] to stop protection prayers instead.

[[File:Rune scimitar detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''rune scimitar''' is a [[scimitar]] requiring level 40 [[Attack]] to wield. It can be created with 2 [[runite bar]]s at level 90 [[Smithing]], or dropped by various monsters such as [[Zamorak warrior]]s or [[Fire giant]]s. 

It is the second strongest scimitar available behind the [[Dragon scimitar]], and the strongest scimitar in [[free-to-play]]. Furthermore, it is considered the strongest [[melee weapon]] in most situations in free-to-play due to its unmatched attack and strength bonuses for its attack speed.

[[Ironmen]] may prefer to create a [[barronite mace]] or purchase a [[rune sword]] from the [[Champions' Guild]] (requiring 32 [[Quest points]]). [[Members]]-only alternatives to the rune scimitar include the [[rapier]] (after [[Cabin Fever]]), [[brine sabre]], and [[ancient staff]] (after [[Desert Treasure I]]). 

Players can attach a [[Rune scimitar ornament kit (Guthix)|Guthix]], [[Rune scimitar ornament kit (Saradomin)|Saradomin]] or [[Rune scimitar ornament kit (Zamorak)|Zamorak ornament kit]], obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]], to create a [[rune scimitar (guthix)|Guthix]], [[Rune scimitar (saradomin)|Saradomin]] and [[Rune scimitar (zamorak)|Zamorak rune scimitar]], respectively. This only alters its appearance, and gives no stat enhancements, though the Saradomin and Zamorak variants will provide protection from the respective factions in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. It can be dismantled at any time, returning the scimitar and ornament kit.

The '''dragon scimitar (or)''' is a [[dragon scimitar]] with a [[dragon scimitar ornament kit]] attached to it. The attached ornament kit gives no additional bonuses, and is only used to add aesthetics to the scimitar. It costs {{Coins|{{GEP|Dragon scimitar}}+{{GEP|Dragon scimitar ornament kit}}}} for both the parts to make the dragon scimitar (or). It can only be wielded by players who have 60 [[Attack]] and have completed the [[Monkey Madness I]] quest. It also shares similar bonuses with [[Viggora's chainmace]], with the chainmace being a [[crush weapon]] rather than a [[slash weapon]].

While the scimitar is untradeable in its ornamented state, it can be dismantled anytime, returning the tradeable scimitar and ornament kit.
